skills.title: SDK code correctness
skills.description: Use for changed TypeScript implementation, types, errors, public callers, input mutation, or code-level secrets and injection.

skills.title: SDK public API and package architecture
skills.description: Use for exports, package boundaries, Client/Entity/Action ownership, stateless requirements, public types, packaging, dependencies, or deprecation.

skills.title: Morpho protocol semantics
skills.description: Use for ABI/address or typed-data changes, transaction routing, protocol entities, accrual, rounding, LLTV, shares, native wrapping, allocator fees or penalties.

skills.title: Wallet and transaction safety
skills.description: Use for transaction parameters, chain/account validation, approvals, permits, typed-data signatures, nonces, deadlines, or dependent onchain operations.

skills.title: SDK failure propagation
skills.description: Use for catches, promises, optional lookups, retries/fallback, returned errors, callbacks, loading/error states, or transaction outcome handling.

skills.title: SDK conventions and release intent
skills.description: Use for imports, semantic helper reuse, generated sources, package source or version changes, changesets, or maintained runtime/peer dependents.

skills.title: SDK API and repository documentation
skills.description: Use for public exports, JSDoc, changed behavior described by docs, Markdown links, renamed files/symbols, repository rules, or TIB changes.

skills.title: SDK behavior and fork evidence
skills.description: Use for changed public behavior, new/error branches, tests or Vitest routing, generated schemas, or RPC/contract paths requiring transport or pinned-fork evidence.

skills.title: SDK CI, dependency and release security
skills.description: Use for workflows/actions, CI/release scripts, changesets, manifests/lockfiles, install settings, dependency changes, publishing commands, or privileged credentials.

skills.title: SDK review and agent instruction integrity
skills.description: Use for .review manifests/criteria, .agents/.claude/.codex commands, skills, AGENTS/CLAUDE guidance, or review workflow/instruction changes.
